label: For "IT Ops Agent Action Guardrails": Gate and record every change AI operations agents make to servers, cloud accounts and ticket workflows so on-call engineers can trust automation without losing sight of what it did. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Permanent administrator accounts.
